title: The verifier's contract-event check over the board: definitions and boards, with the row 4.4
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-events-vectors.py, from verifier-ceremony-vectors.py and the records of contract-event.json and contract-event-v2.json (independent Python implementations)

cases.description: Definition version 1 pinning contract-event version 1: every honest record of contract-event.json, in its order, each passing the event check. 4.4 stays unverifiable (not-implemented): the required entries and the accumulator's replay wait on L2 reads and the archive.
Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 2: every honest record of contract-event-v2.json, the board's events included, each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.
Definition version 3 pinning board-entry version 3 and contract-event version 2: a ballot, a share receipt and a group creation, each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.
No contract-event record on the copy: 4.4 is not-implemented, never a pass, since which events must be boarded isn't known yet.

Contract-event version 2: an honest creation, a ballot whose hash topic disagrees with its record (event-data), then a version-1 encoding, which doesn't decode under the version-2 pin (decode, profile-mismatch). The first failure in copy order decides 4.4: event-data at entry 1.
